## Design

### 2026-10-24 – yahh entry 1

**5.22h**

yahh entry 1

so i started a project which is inspired by khatak a indian classical dance cause i did it in my middle school even though i wanted to continue i couldn't high school

so i started the project i looked at the guide saw what he used and all other thinks but i was unable to concept behind it like how  he know which components ? how he found footprints ? 3d models ? 100 different questions so i decided to actually go into concept understanding so i decided to look after datasheet and got to know about voltage pins and so many new terms like vnn vbus much more

![Screenshot 2026-10-22 155704](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/k9cK7RFJqruSmBgZjJV0pElVN8uP2ZCX/81bb8ce126f8b774a20f08ba1ebf4624d0819c08db47d5654f0d3f21dcd28d8c.png)

then i got to understand basics and stuff so i was looking to guide as guide trying to understand different symbols i did mistakes so many instead of led in starting i added someother symbol

then i came to the finalize of my idea the khatak which is 5 emotions presenting 5 ways of parana which is soul of human according to khatak

then i decided to work on it we need just some change form the guide full of software change since i know python more than half its a freedom for me to go for it

then i started working on it there was this voltage of led confused alot to me i was thinking is the datasheet i am looking at is wrong or it is wrong cause the limit shows from 3.7v to 5.5v then i asked in slack it was mistake then i searched and watching electronics somemore on youtube then i relalise i cant use 5 v cause its connected to usb  so i cant use it then slack again then meghana saw it then it was changed to 5v and also we can usb connection to leds as well and 3.3v is also fine it is just that lights will be dim then i understood concept behind it alot more .

i choosed to work with esp32 - s3 -smd rotarty encoder switches capacitor resistor i added cap res cause for every emotion light should spark according to the intensity of music so thats why

then i tried to arrange footprints
i cant find this esp32-s3-smd so i changed it to guide one so it will be easy for me to add symbol footprint and 3d model and stuff yahh

i can say alot more but thats it cause already 2000 words
